"Licking Cream" is a song by the American rock band Sevendust. It was released as a single from their second studio album, Home (1999). "Licking Cream" was the band's first song to be released as a single in Europe. It features additional vocals by Skin, lead singer of the English rock band Skunk Anansie.
Music video
The music video for "Licking Cream" was directed by Ben Joe Dempsey. The video was made depicting the band playing in a dilapidated apartment building.
